rules.text: If the plotted line is the yearly temperature-reading series requested for the 2005-2015 review, the y-axis values increase upward as labeled, and the endpoint markers aligned with the 24 and 10 ticks represent the 2005 and 2015 readings, then the series declines by about 14 plotted units across the period. If that magnitude meets the substantial-trend workflow's unstated follow-up standard, the escalation route is supported.
rules.component: chart encoding, endpoint comparison, and conditional task-to-route relation
rules.conditions: Applies only if the line is the relevant yearly temperature series, the labeled y-axis scale validly encodes the readings, and a decline of about 14 units qualifies as substantial under the workflow.

rules.text: A visible multi-year decline alone does not determine whether escalation or routine monitoring is required when the public task identifies magnitude as the routing criterion but supplies no quantitative substantial-trend cutoff or other decision rule. A route remains underdetermined unless that omitted standard can be established from the provided chart or public task.
rules.conditions: Applies to the supplied public task and chart only; it does not infer a threshold from customary practice or from an option's wording.

rules.text: If the task’s reference to yearly temperature readings is taken to require a complete annual observation for every year from 2005 through 2015, the visible chart must show or otherwise identify a 2011 reading before completeness of that annual series can be established. The absence of an explicitly displayed 2011 point does not alter the visible 2005 and 2015 endpoint positions, but it leaves complete yearly coverage unverified.
rules.conditions: Applies only to interpreting the displayed line as a complete annual record rather than as the set of years visibly plotted.
